standard_prerequisites.use: The relative conormal-differentials sequence for immersions of algebraic spaces (same chapter, lemma-differentials-relative-immersion, collected as S3-spaces-differentials-rel-immersion) and the etale localization of differentials and conormal sheaves (same chapter); cited inputs with the splitting claim written in the retained span.

core_obligations: State the splitting claim: for a left inverse g of i over B, i^*c_g is a right inverse of i^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B}.
Reduce the scheme-local verification to the corresponding result for morphisms of schemes.
Conclude etale local split exactness via the localization lemmas.

proof_roadmap.step: Identify the right inverse induced by a left inverse of the immersion.
Descend to the schemes case by etale localization.

difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over B that etale locally has a left inverse, the canonical sequence 0 -> C_{Z/X} -> i^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B} -> 0 of the relative differentials lemma is etale locally split exact. The retained proof writes out the key claim explicitly: given a left inverse g : X -> Z over B, the pullback i^*c_g of the conormal comparison map along g is a right inverse of i^*Omega_{X/B} -> Omega_{Z/B}; the existence of this splitting map then reduces to the corresponding statement for morphisms of schemes by etale localization through the chapter's localize-differentials and etale-conormal lemmas. Retained author proof at lines 1193-1201.
